student_problem: Students do not know where to find legitimate scholarships and programs
suggested_support: Teach search strategies; use verified provider directories; compare official requirements

student_problem: Students struggle to interpret age, grade, country and citizenship rules
suggested_support: Break requirements into country, age, grade, residency and prerequisite fields
observable_learning_outcome: Explain why a listing may or may not fit

student_problem: Students cannot distinguish fully funded, partially funded and fee-based programs
suggested_support: Show tuition, travel, accommodation, meals, stipend and hidden-cost fields separately

student_problem: Students miss deadlines across time zones and application portals
suggested_support: Use a deadline calendar with timezone, reminders and status tracking

student_problem: Students know social platforms but lack professional digital workflows
suggested_support: Teach file naming, cloud folders, online forms, email etiquette and account safety

student_problem: Students are unsure how to contact teachers, mentors and program teams
suggested_support: Provide email structure, subject lines, polite follow-ups and message examples

student_problem: Students do not know how to build genuine academic relationships
suggested_support: Teach thoughtful outreach, informational questions and follow-up etiquette

student_problem: Students hesitate to ask for help or apply when they meet most requirements
suggested_support: Use evidence-based self-assessment, question prompts and application planning
observable_learning_outcome: Ask for support and assess opportunities realistically

student_problem: Students struggle to describe projects, volunteering and school activities
suggested_support: Teach achievement statements, project summaries and honest evidence

student_problem: Students struggle to explain their experiences clearly
suggested_support: Practise structured answers, examples, listening and follow-up questions
observable_learning_outcome: Answer common interview questions with evidence

student_problem: Students struggle to turn experiences into coherent personal statements
suggested_support: Teach brainstorming, outlining, specific examples, revision and voice

student_problem: Students ask for recommendations too late or provide little context
suggested_support: Teach early requests, deadlines, activity summaries and respectful follow-up

student_problem: Students find it difficult to sustain attention on demanding work
suggested_support: Teach distraction audits, focused work blocks and realistic breaks

student_problem: Students rely heavily on rereading and highlighting
suggested_support: Teach retrieval practice, practice questions and self-explanation
observable_learning_outcome: Use active recall on a topic

student_problem: Students forget material after tests
suggested_support: Teach spaced review schedules and cumulative practice

student_problem: Students struggle with dense texts and unfamiliar vocabulary
suggested_support: Teach annotation, summarising, questioning and vocabulary logs

student_problem: Students have ideas but struggle to organize them in writing
suggested_support: Teach paragraph structure, thesis, evidence and editing

student_problem: Students accept online claims without checking evidence
suggested_support: Teach source evaluation, claims, evidence, assumptions and counterarguments
observable_learning_outcome: Evaluate a claim using credible sources

student_problem: Students wait for step-by-step instructions on unfamiliar tasks
suggested_support: Teach problem decomposition, hypothesis testing and reflection
observable_learning_outcome: Break an open-ended problem into steps

student_problem: Students underestimate tasks and overcommit
suggested_support: Teach weekly planning, prioritization and task estimation

student_problem: Students set vague goals without measurable next actions
suggested_support: Teach specific goals, milestones and review cycles
observable_learning_outcome: Convert a broad goal into weekly actions

student_problem: Students lack basic budgeting and cost-comparison skills
suggested_support: Teach needs versus wants, simple budgets, saving and financial safety

student_problem: Students may overshare personal information online
suggested_support: Teach privacy settings, phishing awareness and data minimization

student_problem: Students face pressure without practical healthy coping routines
suggested_support: Teach workload planning, breaks, help-seeking and sleep-supportive routines

student_problem: Students interpret setbacks as proof they cannot succeed
suggested_support: Teach reflection, feedback use and iterative goal adjustment
observable_learning_outcome: Use feedback to improve a plan

student_problem: Students lack access to people who can explain unfamiliar pathways
suggested_support: Teach how to find trusted mentors and prepare useful questions

student_problem: Students have few chances to apply classroom knowledge
suggested_support: Suggest school projects, volunteering, clubs and community challenges

student_problem: Students struggle with role clarity and collaborative work
suggested_support: Teach role allocation, communication norms and conflict resolution

student_problem: Students feel unprepared to present ideas to an audience
suggested_support: Teach audience awareness, structure, rehearsal and feedback

student_problem: Students may have limited devices, data or stable connectivity
suggested_support: Offer low-bandwidth content, downloadable guides and offline planning

student_problem: Students cannot connect school activities to longer-term goals
suggested_support: Use values reflection, interest mapping and small experiments

student_problem: Noise, interruptions or shared devices disrupt learning
suggested_support: Teach environment planning, offline options and communication of needs

student_problem: Students face too many resources and cannot choose what matters
suggested_support: Teach source quality, relevance filters and learning objectives
observable_learning_outcome: Select a credible resource for a goal

student_problem: Students feel pressure to choose a career too early
suggested_support: Teach exploration through projects, interviews and skill experiments

student_problem: Students may encounter fake scholarships or fee scams
suggested_support: Teach red flags, official-domain checks and independent verification
observable_learning_outcome: Check a listing before sharing data or paying

student_problem: Learning materials may not work for students with disabilities
suggested_support: Use captions, keyboard navigation, readable layouts and accessible formats

student_problem: Students may struggle with application language
suggested_support: Teach vocabulary preparation, plain-language summaries and translation review

student_problem: Students know a goal but do not know what to do first
suggested_support: Use guided checklists, milestone plans and progress reviews
